title: forge project configuration
description: Project-side configuration for the forge plugin, stored at .claude/forge.json. Every value belongs to the project; the plugin ships none of them. Strict JSON, no comments, no unknown keys at any level.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema for editor support.

version.description: Config format version. Currently 1. Bumped only when a key changes meaning.

taskFiles.description: Grep-only working files (lessons, todo, sprint, spokes) and how the session-start injector reads them.

lessons.description: Repo-relative path to the lessons file. Grep-only; must carry a '## Index' section per the Index Contract (D6).

todo.description: Repo-relative path to the todo file. Injected item-level (open checkboxes) as the documented exception to index-only injection.

sprint.description: Repo-relative path to the sprint file.

handoff.description: Repo-relative path to the handoff note (formats.md handoff template). Injected head-first (default mode head-25). Its YAML header's forge_version, when it differs from the running forge, makes session start ask for the conflict check (opusjevos D-BM).

spokesDir.description: Repo-relative directory holding hand-rolled per-agent memory spokes (kept alongside native agent memory for one release, D4).

caps.description: Maximum line counts per file kind. Wrap-up warns when a file exceeds its cap.

lessons.description: Line cap for the lessons file (e.g. 400).

todo.description: Line cap for the todo file (e.g. 1000).

sprint.description: Line cap for the sprint file (e.g. 100).

injectionBudget.description: Total bytes the session-start injector may emit across all task files (e.g. 8192). Content beyond the budget is truncated with a notice.

injectionMode.description: Per-file injection mode. Keys are the taskFiles key names (lessons, todo, sprint) or a spoke path. Values: 'index' (emit the ## Index section), 'open-items' (emit unchecked checkboxes), or 'head-N' (emit the first N lines).

decisionsLog.description: Repo-relative path to the decisions log written by brainstorm and wrap-up.

auditsDir.description: Repo-relative directory where audit and audit-framework reports are written.

hubs.description: Hub-and-spoke memory (opusjevos D-BN, D-BO). Spoke files hold entries headed '### <ID> | <YYYY-MM-DD> | <1-3 labels> | <one sentence>'; the forge hub script (scripts/hub/hub.js) rebuilds each hub's '## Index' from its spokes, newest first, and rejects labels not in the labels file. Session start injects each hub's Index within injectionBudget.

labels.description: Repo-relative path to labels.md: the 12 standard labels plus this repo's own, one '- <label>: <meaning>' line each. Only listed labels are allowed.

items.description: One hub: the generated file and the spoke files it indexes.

hub.description: Repo-relative path of the generated hub file.

spokes.description: Repo-relative paths of the spoke files this hub indexes.

git.description: Branching and merge policy enforced by the guard hooks.

baseBranch.description: Branch PRs target and worktrees start from (e.g. 'main').

branchPrefix.description: Prefix for work branches (e.g. 'feat/'). Used by dispatch when naming a unit's branch.

worktreeDir.description: Directory (relative to the repo or absolute) where worktrees are created.

draftPrRequired.description: When true the pr-create guard denies 'gh pr create' without --draft.

squashOnly.description: When true the merge-gate guard denies any merge that is not a squash merge.

merge.description: Merge control (D32): how the human's decision to change the base branch reaches the guards. Nothing lands on git.baseBranch without a human marker, a spoken 'merge' (if enabled), or a one-tap approval.

spokenWord.description: Default false. When true, a user message that is ONLY a merge command ('merge', 'merge to main', 'merge PR 12') writes a single-use, 15-minute marker. Ships off: Claude Code's docs do not say whether the hook can tell a human-typed message from a harness-injected one. Turn on only after the live probe in docs/plans/merge-control.md.

ask.description: Default true. When no marker exists, return a one-tap approval ('ask') instead of a deny, in permission modes where an ask reaches the human (default, acceptEdits, plan).

askInAutoMode.description: Default false. Also ask under permission mode 'auto'. Leave false until a live probe shows an ask still reaches the human there; with false, merges to the base branch are denied in auto mode unless a marker exists.

requireChildTests.description: Default true. A pull request into a NON-base branch (a child unit into its parent) merges only when its checks all pass. Failing or still-running checks deny; no checks or unreadable checks ask or deny, never pass.

commands.description: Command policy: what CI owns, what is slow, how CI and lint run.

ciOwned.description: Regexes (matched against the lowercased Bash command) for commands CI owns. The ci-owned-command guard denies them locally.

scopedTestExample.description: Example of a correctly scoped local test command, shown in the ci-owned-command deny reason.

slow.description: Regexes for commands that must run in the background. The slow-command hook reminds rather than denies.

ci.description: How CI is wired, for skills that reason about it.

triggerBranches.description: Branches or patterns that trigger CI.

deploy.description: Free text describing how deploys happen; may state 'owner-only'.

readDiscipline.description: Limits agents apply to themselves when reading files.

grepOnly.description: Globs for files that are never read whole; agents grep then read a range.

maxDocLines.description: Maximum lines an agent reads from a document in one call.

maxBytes.description: Maximum bytes an agent reads in one call.

delegation.description: Which paths the coordinator may edit inline and which must be delegated.

inlineAllow.description: Globs the coordinator may edit inline without a delegation reminder.

delegatedPaths.description: Globs that must be handed to a worker agent.

agents.description: Per-agent overrides keyed by agent name (implementer, bug-fixer, test-writer, reviewer, doc-updater, explorer, or a project agent).

budget.description: Tool-call budget override. The agent reserves its last 3 calls for the report.

domainSkills.description: Skill names to preload for this agent.

spoke.description: Repo-relative path to this agent's hand-rolled memory spoke.

extraChecks.description: reviewer only: extra checks appended to the review checklist.

additionalProperties.description: Overrides for one agent. Keys are optional; unset keys fall back to the agent definition.

stack.description: One-line stack description and formatter, so the plugin itself stays stack-free.

line.description: One-line stack summary injected at session start.

command.description: Formatter command; receives file paths as arguments.

glob.description: Glob of files the formatter applies to.

tiers.description: Risk tiers by path (D17). Sets gates (D18), merge policy (D19), agent budget and review model per tier.

T0.description: T0 docs/bookkeeping: docs, tasks, changelog fragments, comment-only edits. Gates: validators + one reviewer pass per batch. Merge: same human-controlled merge to the base branch as every tier (D32). All keys optional. Highest matching tier wins for a PR.

paths.description: Globs matched against repo-relative paths of changed files. A file matching no tier is treated as T2.

budget.description: Tool-call budget for worker agents on units in this tier. Overrides agents.<name>.budget; a prompt override still wins.

reviewModel.description: Model the reviewer agent uses for units in this tier. Overrides agents.reviewer.model; a prompt override still wins.

T1.description: T1 framework/config: .claude/, hooks, workflows, settings. Gates: hook harness + hook tests + reviewer + CI. Merge: explicit human merge. All keys optional. Highest matching tier wins for a PR.

paths.description: Globs matched against repo-relative paths of changed files. A file matching no tier is treated as T2.

budget.description: Tool-call budget for worker agents on units in this tier. Overrides agents.<name>.budget; a prompt override still wins.

reviewModel.description: Model the reviewer agent uses for units in this tier. Overrides agents.reviewer.model; a prompt override still wins.

T2.description: T2 app code: src, tests, scripts. Gates: implementer, test-writer, reviewer, CI. Merge: explicit human merge. All keys optional. Highest matching tier wins for a PR.

paths.description: Globs matched against repo-relative paths of changed files. A file matching no tier is treated as T2.

budget.description: Tool-call budget for worker agents on units in this tier. Overrides agents.<name>.budget; a prompt override still wins.

reviewModel.description: Model the reviewer agent uses for units in this tier. Overrides agents.reviewer.model; a prompt override still wins.

T3.description: T3 money/auth/data/deploy: payments, webhook signatures, migrations, deploy config. Gates: T2 plus security review plus an owner-facing diff summary. Merge: explicit human merge. All keys optional. Highest matching tier wins for a PR.

paths.description: Globs matched against repo-relative paths of changed files. A file matching no tier is treated as T2.

budget.description: Tool-call budget for worker agents on units in this tier. Overrides agents.<name>.budget; a prompt override still wins.

reviewModel.description: Model the reviewer agent uses for units in this tier. Overrides agents.reviewer.model; a prompt override still wins.

changelog.description: Changelog fragments (D21). Each PR adds one fragment; close-out assembles them into the changelog under a dated header and deletes them.

file.description: Repo-relative path of the assembled changelog (e.g. 'CHANGELOG.md').

fragmentsDir.description: Repo-relative directory holding per-PR fragments (e.g. 'changelog.d'). Each fragment is <slug>.md with a section name line and one or more bullets.

telemetry.description: Metadata-only telemetry sink (D29). Hooks buffer records to a local JSONL file; a flush hook batches and POSTs them to the consuming project's ingest endpoint. Best-effort and non-blocking; forge itself hardcodes no URL.

enabled.description: Master switch for telemetry emission and flush. Default off; telemetry is inert unless the consuming project opts in.

sinkUrl.description: HTTPS endpoint telemetry batches are POSTed to (the consuming project's ingest URL). Must be HTTPS (https://…); a plaintext http:// sink is rejected so the Bearer token is never sent in the clear. Generic; forge ships no default.

projectKey.description: Identifier tagging every emitted record so one sink can hold telemetry from multiple repos.

tokenEnv.description: NAME of the environment variable holding the per-repo ingest token. The token itself is never stored in config.

maxBatchBytes.description: Maximum serialized size (bytes) of a single POST body. The flush hook splits each session's records into chunks whose JSON stays under this cap so one oversized POST cannot be permanently rejected (e.g. HTTP 413). Generic; forge ships no consumer-specific limit and defaults to 90000 when unset. A single record whose own batch exceeds the cap is dropped to avoid permanent stranding.

mode.description: Hard constraint on what is sent: only metadata is ever transmitted, never prompt/response or customer content.

memory.description: Agent memory policy over Claude Code's native per-agent memory layout (D28/D30). Native auto-memory stays off; forge gates writes through a propose-then-curate flow.

recall.description: Whether agents read their native-layout memory (MEMORY.md hub + topic spokes) at task start.

writeMode.description: Write gating: agents propose lessons in a hand-back block and the main context is the sole writer. Claude Code's built-in auto-memory is binary with no recall-only mode, so writes are gated this way.

excludeFromWrite.description: Agent names whose proposals are never persisted (compliance carve-out for consuming projects with sensitive agents).
